title: Rhizome soft rot of ginger - Nepal

Header: Rhizome soft rot of ginger - Nepal
Pythium aphanidermatum , Pythium myriotylum Aduwako gano kuhine rog

Prevention: Don't grow ginger in fields that have been infested previously.
While preparing field, apply neem cake in soil @ 10kg/ropani in to the soil to control rhizome fly.
Always use healthy rhizome as planting material.
Rotate crop with finger millet, maize or wheat.
Avoid dense planting of crop; recommended spacing is 45 x 30-35cm.
Avoid waterlogging in field by providing good drainage.
Monitoring: Inspect the crop weekly, check for wilting plants and rhizome rot.
Take disease management action in the whole field if one case of rhizome rot is confirmed.
Direct Control: Uproot infected plants along with rhizomes and destroy them.

Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
